title: MOATTERS reproducibility code
description: Version-locked and rerun-validated reproducibility code for modular, observable, auditable, and traceable task-conditioned evidence reconstruction into patient-level molecular-functional states. The release includes TCGA-BRCA derivation and reference audit, independent external validation in METABRIC and GSE96058/SCAN-B, cross-cancer applicability analyses in TCGA-KIRC and TCGA-LUAD, evidence synthesis, singleton-component audit, and matched GSVA/Pathifier benchmarking.
